items.translation: 通常由带有@EnableTransactionManagement注解的@Configuration类实现。 有关通用示例和上下文，请参见@EnableTransactionManagement； 有关详细操作说明，请参见annotationDrivenTransactionManager()。

items.source: Note that in by-type lookup disambiguation cases, an alternative approach to implementing this interface is to simply mark one of the offending PlatformTransactionManager @Bean methods (or ReactiveTransactionManager @Bean methods) as @Primary. This is even generally preferred since it doesn't lead to early initialization of the TransactionManager bean.
items.translation: 请注意，在按类型查找的消歧情况下，实现此接口的一种替代方法是简单地将其中一个有问题的 `PlatformTransactionManager` `@Bean` 方法（或 `ReactiveTransactionManager` `@Bean` 方法）标记为 @Primary。这通常更受青睐，因为它不会导致 `TransactionManager` Bean 的早期初始化。

items.source: In either scenario #1 or #2, it is important that the PlatformTransactionManager instance is managed as a Spring bean within the container since most PlatformTransactionManager implementations take advantage of Spring lifecycle callbacks such as InitializingBean and BeanFactoryAware. Note that the same guidelines apply to ReactiveTransactionManager beans.
items.translation: 在场景 #1 或 #2 中，重要的是将 `PlatformTransactionManager` 实例作为 Spring 容器中的 Spring Bean 进行管理，因为大多数 `PlatformTransactionManager` 实现利用了 Spring 生命周期回调（如 `InitializingBean` 和 `BeanFactoryAware`）。请注意，相同的指南也适用于 `ReactiveTransactionManager` Bean。

items.source: NOTE: A TransactionManagementConfigurer will get initialized early. Do not inject common dependencies into autowired fields directly; instead, consider declaring a lazy ObjectProvider for those.
items.translation: 注意：TransactionManagementConfigurer 会较早初始化。 不要直接将公共依赖注入到自动装配字段中；相反，考虑为这些依赖声明一个懒加载的ObjectProvider。
